_description: Hand-curated Minimalist Chat retrieval judgments. These questions are phrased like a non-expert would ask them. Results are source-aware so the later code source cannot false-pass a vault-note judgment.

queries.query: If I had to explain Minimalist Chat to a friend in one sentence, what problem does it solve?
Without jargon, what are the main pieces the app is built from, from the web screen to data, mobile apps, servers, and payments?
What should the team build next to make the product feel more complete, and which ideas were deliberately postponed?
When someone asks the website's AI a question, what prevents their browser from reaching the raw model on my computer?
Why are GBrain and Winston connected to different Ollama addresses, and which one uses the normal tray app?
Can I view Minimalist Analysis while away from home without giving a remote webpage control over my Windows computer?
If ninety AI jobs are already running, what happens to the next one, and how is the user's Banana charge kept safe?
How did the public site's phone and desktop Lighthouse scores change from the first test to the final live test?
What keeps a long chat session or repeatedly opened hidden tabs from growing memory, listeners, and network work forever?
Which audit fixes stopped people from forging notifications, rewriting someone else's messages, or bypassing room permissions?
Why are account subscriptions sent to a separate customer portal from room billing, and how are duplicate or wrong-owner Stripe customers handled?
What are the five buttons in the signed-in phone dock, and where do Search, Vault, and Settings live now?
How can a phone user load older private messages without losing their place, and when does the layout switch to two panes?
Who is Winston, where should the gorilla picture appear, and why does the sparkle icon stay in navigation?
On the calendar's Scan schedule action, what is the difference between Take photo and Import picture, especially on phones?
